_note: v2.4 plan 05 T12 live (real LLM; so-scenario run <file> --sandbox --group <the sun-ruins group>, twice). Needs the Xentar Checkpoints book listed; since 2026-10-02 the runtime scans it in the chats that play sun-ruins (requirements source story), so it must not be selected globally (the eval fails naming what is missing rather than selecting it). The sun-ruins start checkpoint switches on the CONSTANT entries 'CP1 - Mission' and 'CP1 - Scenario' (examples/sun-ruins/Xentar Checkpoints.json uids 9, 5). 'CP1 - Mission' carries an authored character filter (DM Narrator only; world-info.js:4816 checks it before the constant check), which the first live run found: the gated-constant flag fired on every other member's turn. So the fixture drafts exactly one member per generation with /trigger: (1) DM Narrator: both constants fire with origin 'gated' and no lore-constant-missed is journaled; (2) Arin: CP1 - Scenario fires, CP1 - Mission is filtered out, and no flag is raised, because an authored character filter is not a miss. If the world info budget or probability ever drops one, the flag, not this fixture, is the evidence: the fixture fails naming the flag. Rewritten 2026-09-25 after the first live runs: the `send` verb is `/send compact` and never generated, and a player send in a group drafts an unknown number of members.

requires.why: real /trigger drafts of DM Narrator and Arin through the T12 ring

steps.eval: const trig = async (name) => { const ev = globalThis.storyOrchestratorLoreEvidence; const before = ev.slotsForChat().length; await SillyTavern.getContext().executeSlashCommandsWithOptions(`/trigger await=true "${name}"`, { handleParserErrors: false }); for (let i = 0; i < 240 && ev.slotsForChat().length <= before; i += 1) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); return ev.slotsForChat().length - before; }; const view = () => globalThis.storyOrchestratorLoreEvidence.view(globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getStory(), globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook?.name ?? null); const missed = () => globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSessionJournal().slice(globalThis.__v2405const.journal).filter((event) => event.kind === 'lore' && event.summary.startsWith('lore-constant-missed')); const added = await trig('DM Narrator'); const last = view().last; if (!added || !last) throw new Error('no evidence slot for the DM Narrator reply'); const gated = last.fired.filter((row) => row.origin === 'gated').map((row) => row.comment); if (missed().length) throw new Error(`lore-constant-missed was raised on the narrator's own turn: ${missed().map((event) => JSON.stringify(event.detail ?? event.summary)).join(' | ')}`); for (const comment of ['CP1 - Mission', 'CP1 - Scenario']) if (!gated.includes(comment)) throw new Error(`the gated constant ${comment} is not in the DM Narrator reply's activations: ${JSON.stringify(last.fired.map((row) => `${row.comment}:${row.origin}`))}`); return { narrator: gated, scans: last.scanCount, rendered: last.rendered };
